verifiedObservedFacts.fact: The captured run installed an available game package, created and selected the Vibe2Study world, then entered the actual first-person 3D world with the mobile HUD visible.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: World creation and selection are preserved as setup stages; gameplay entry is claimed only from the captured 3D world view.

verifiedObservedFacts.fact: A bounded horizontal look swipe on the live first-person play surface changed the captured camera view from a close tree-and-forest framing to a different view exposing the coastline and surrounding trees.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: Only the directly captured touch-to-camera response is promoted; world-generation algorithms, physics, interaction internals and hidden game rules are not inferred.

verifiedObservedFacts.fact: The net.minetest.minetest package remained alive and foreground in GameActivity after world entry and the look swipe with no captured FATAL EXCEPTION, SIGABRT, SIGSEGV or ANR marker.
verifiedObservedFacts.boundary: This proves the captured validation window and does not claim indefinite long-run stability.

distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.lesson: Installing content, creating a world and selecting that world are meaningful setup milestones but are not equivalent to actual sandbox gameplay entry.
distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: For Roblox flows with lobbies, loadouts or world selection, preserve setup milestones separately and require the real controllable 3D play state before claiming gameplay entry.

distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.lesson: A short horizontal touch gesture on the first-person play surface produced an immediate, clearly visible camera-orientation change while the movement and action HUD remained available.
distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: For Roblox mobile 3D controls, validate look gestures with before/after scene framing while preserving consistent movement and action affordances.

distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.lesson: The world launch needed a bounded loading window before first-person gameplay could be visually verified and exercised.
distilledPositiveRuntimePatterns.reuseRule: Do not inject or judge gameplay input before the target Roblox play state is visibly ready; bind input evidence to the post-load playable frame.

distilledFailurePatterns.lesson: Earlier bounded probes hit neighboring menu actions such as content-page or new-world controls even though the application runtime was healthy.
distilledFailurePatterns.reuseRule: When adjacent mobile controls are close together, classify a mis-tap as an automation-coordinate failure, correct it from the captured frame, and rerun the responsible stage without lowering the game-entry gate.

allowed: portable mobile 3D-control lessons that may inform later Roblox-specific implementation and verification
stillForbidden: treating Android evidence as Roblox runtime evidence
inferring or copying world-generation, physics or hidden interaction algorithms
copying bundled game artwork, UI trade dress, world content or implementation details into a Roblox game
claims about long-run sandbox progression, balance or performance not measured by the captured validation window
